title: Feature 024 draft fragment of workflow.schema.json (additive v1, ADR-0032)
description: Draft $defs merged by T024-008 into specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/workflow.schema.json. The node union gains dataTransform, dataQuery and dataPublish; the closed database node and the closed icebergWrite node (feature 035) gain the optional property assets (databaseAssets). Data nodes, like database nodes, are allowed only in the root graph of a graph-model definition without forEach, while, repeatUntil, continueAsNew or chainPolicy, outside saga bodies, and declare no destinations. Publication additionally checks the instance-registry capability data-pipelines-v1 (refused VALIDATION_FAILED reason DATA_PIPELINES_NOT_ENABLED until it is recorded), the asset catalog, producer bindings, contract compatibility and root-only placement, and that a node names each output asset and each input alias at most once (VALIDATION_FAILED reason DATA_NODE_SCOPE; JSON Schema uniqueItems cannot express a unique property, so publication checks it). References to #/$defs/nodeId, #/$defs/expression and #/$defs/databaseParameter name the canonical definitions. Revised 2026-11-26 against develop at e5bda041, and 2026-11-27 after the correctness review (Decision 024-016).

revision.description: Optional explicit declaration revision; otherwise the current revision is pinned at run admission.

from.description: With asset: read the snapshot this earlier dataTransform node of the same run committed in its successful completion (in a run created by an 018 reset, the snapshot its restored data.snapshot_committed names) instead of the published one; must be a predecessor on every path; resolves only an AUDITED or PUBLISHED snapshot (a quarantined one fails DATA_INPUT_QUARANTINED; an ABANDONED or RETIRED one, unreachable while the run pins it, fails DATA_CONFIGURATION_INVALID).

step.description: Ingestion: read the committed output of this earlier step of the same run, either a 017 database result (staged as a typed table) or a step-output blob of type application/vnd.apache.parquet (verified like a part). Must be a predecessor on every path; excludes asset and from. In a dataQuery a step source MUST NOT be a 017 database step (publication refuses it, VALIDATION_FAILED reason DATA_NODE_SCOPE, so a database result keeps the 017 database:result:read audience); any other step source counts as pii unless the source step's output is a feature 016 carrier whose pinned schema declares a level for every field (FR-024-016, FR-024-029).

statement.description: duckdb only: one SELECT over the input aliases; required for duckdb, forbidden for polars.

dataLimits.description: Author may lower, never raise, the effective ceilings of the plan. The data runner sends the data-mode sandbox runner only the smallest configured budget class (small, large) that covers memoryBytes, cpus, spillBytes and snapshotBytes (Architecture decision 0079 rule 5: a request names a class, never a limit); the values themselves are enforced in software below the class budget (DuckDB memory_limit, staged and streamed bytes). Publication refuses limits no configured class covers.

memoryBytes.description: Container memory, which also pays for the /out and /spill tmpfs mounts.

script.description: polars only: a published script version of language python-data (reserved by feature 023) whose artifact is design 046's bundle version 5 with the version's own lock (ecosystem pypi), pinned at publication. Polars, PyArrow and any library come from its signed read-only layer; there is no platform catalog (Owner decision 2026-11-26-162).

scriptInput.description: polars only: bounded JSON value passed to the script.

outputs.description: Each output names a different asset (publication refuses a repeated asset name, VALIDATION_FAILED reason DATA_NODE_SCOPE).

timeoutMs.description: Lease deadline of the whole attempt: staging, transform, upload, read-back, audit and report. The transform's wall time (default 10 minutes) is bounded by what is left after limits.auditTimeoutMs and a fixed staging allowance; publication refuses a value that leaves the transform less than 60 seconds.

dataQuery.description: Data node: one DuckDB SELECT over pinned inputs, run in the data sandbox as sagat.data.query, writing nothing. Its output is the 017 typed-cell result shape, inline and at most 256 KiB, and a 016 classification carrier whose platform-derived schema carries the highest level among the pinned inputs: an asset input at the highest level of its pinned columns, a step source at pii unless its source output is a 016 carrier declaring a level for every field. A step source that is a 017 database step is refused at publication (DATA_NODE_SCOPE). Root-only like dataTransform. Not a database node and not served by the 017 result view.

dataPublish.description: Engine node, no worker: compare-and-set of the asset pointer to the snapshot the from node committed in its successful completion (in a run created by an 018 reset, the snapshot its restored data.snapshot_committed names), in the reducer transaction. The producer binding is checked against the from node. Already current is success; a quarantined or missing snapshot fails DATA_AUDIT_FAILED / DATA_CONFIGURATION_INVALID; an ABANDONED snapshot is stale and follows onStale (DATA_PUBLISH_STALE or skip). Its output document is a closed protected record of at most 4 KiB.

databaseAssets.description: Optional property assets of the database node and of the icebergWrite node (feature 035): declared lineage to external assets. A declared write is accepted at publication only if this node is the external asset's producer and uses its connection (a SQL connection for database, an iceberg connection for icebergWrite); a successful step then records one observation per written asset in its completion transaction; an unknown or failed outcome records none. Never inferred from SQL.

outputs.statement: SELECT order_date, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date < $1 GROUP BY 1

examples.statement: SELECT order_date, sum(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
